About Image Fitness

A serious gym, built for real progress.

Image Fitness is a modern gym in Chembur with a spacious environment, imported equipment and professional trainers who actually pay attention to your form. Members consistently mention the knowledgeable and supportive coaching, clean facilities and a genuinely motivating atmosphere.

  • Modern imported equipment across three floors
  • Spacious, air-conditioned workout environment
  • Professional trainers who give personal attention
  • Clean facilities, maintained daily
  • A motivating community that keeps you consistent
